product_one_liner.value: Aviso AI is an AI-powered revenue platform for sales and go-to-market teams that predicts revenue outcomes and guides selling decisions.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page advertises flexible pricing and requests a tailored proposal rather than displaying dollar amounts.

named_customers.notes: Both are subjects of Aviso customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 201–500 employees; the September 2026 Crustdata profile reports 376.

founded_year.notes: Uses Aviso's own stated founding year; some directory profiles instead list 2014.

eng_blog.notes: A public blog and technical articles exist, but the reviewed build-focused articles are attributed to a Research Manager; two engineer-authored posts were not established under the requested definition.

public_docs.notes: The public help center contains multiple product guides covering accounts, deals, forecasting-related workflows, conversational intelligence, MIKI and administration.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists ten openings, none with a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title. Its Data Engineer opening does not count under the specified rule.

model_provider.notes: Aviso explicitly describes MIKI as built using these open-source models alongside its AI/ML/NLP layers.

compliance_certs.notes: The page names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR and PCI DSS Service Provider Level 1. GDPR is a compliance claim, not a certification; the PCI DSS statement appears in its AWS-hosting discussion.

last_funding.notes: The profile, updated September 2026, identifies January 2022 as the latest round and lists its amount as $14 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent reported round was January 2022, before the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive opening is listed for remote candidates in the USA and Canada.

launched_6mo.notes: Aviso announced its agentic AI CSM on June 16, 2026, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page provides no joining dates. Available profiles did not unambiguously establish a C-level or VP joining or leaving during the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are publicly named integrations, not confirmation that Aviso uses each system internally.
